scripts.server-new-local: cd server && rm -fr data/einz.sqlite.db* && npm run dev
scripts.server-new: cd deployment; git pull; rm -fr data/einz.sqlite.db*; docker compose up -d --build server; docker compose down; docker compose up -d; docker compose logs -f server
scripts.ios-boot: xcrun simctl boot 720C22F9-D844-44EE-BDA6-87900913A39B; open -a Simulator; xcrun simctl list devices | grep -i booted
scripts.ios-new: xcrun simctl uninstall booted cc.tic.einz; cd app; flutter run -d 720C22F9-D844-44EE-BDA6-87900913A39B --pid-file /tmp/einz_flutter.pid
scripts.ios-refresh: echo '热重载（只刷新界面，不重置状态）'; kill -USR1 $(cat /tmp/einz_flutter.pid)
scripts.ios-reload: echo '热重启（重启逻辑，重新走启动流程——适合本次改动，能看到进入对话页的最新效果）'; kill -USR2 $(cat /tmp/einz_flutter.pid)
